findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Matrix/Spectrum.lean:30 `variable {𝕜} [RCLike 𝕜]`, :71 `eigenvectorBasis : OrthonormalBasis n 𝕜 …`, :193 `det_eq_prod_eigenvalues`; mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Matrix/PosDef.lean:71-74 proves `posDef_iff_eigenvalues_pos` at RCLike by the same `spectral_theorem`+`isUnit_coe.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff` route used at Spectrum.lean:74-76; `posDef_diagonal_iff` is `StarOrderedRing`-general (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/PosDef.lean:202). TauCeti/Analysis/Matrix/Sqrt.lean:44 already uses `[RCLike 𝕜]` for the same PR's matrix lemmas.
findings.fix: Use `variable {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {B : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hB : B.IsHermitian)` with `c : ℝ`: `det_one_sub_smul : (1 - c • B).det = ∏ j, (1 - c * hB.eigenvalues j : 𝕜)`, `posDef_one_sub_smul_iff` unchanged, and the quadratic-form lemma as `⟪∑ j, c j • hB.eigenvectorBasis j, B.toEuclideanLin _⟫_𝕜 = ∑ j, (hB.eigenvalues j : 𝕜) * ‖c j‖ ^ 2` for `c : ι → 𝕜`; recover the real form used in QuadraticForm.lean by `sq_abs`.
findings.issue: All three new lemmas in the `Matrix.IsHermitian` namespace (`inner_toEuclideanLin_sum_smul_eigenvectorBasis` :47, `one_sub_smul_eq_conjStarAlgAut` :61, `posDef_one_sub_smul_iff` :72, `det_one_sub_smul` :80) are fixed at `B : Matrix ι ι ℝ`, below the level of the Mathlib API they are built from and of the sibling file added in this PR.

findings.evidence: The proof at :109-110 is `simp only [mgf, Finset.mul_sum, Real.exp_sum]; exact integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod …`, and `integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod` is stated for arbitrary sigma-finite `μ : ι → Measure E` and arbitrary `f` (mathlib/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/Pi.lean:67-71, :79-82). The proof at :119-131 uses only that factorisation, `mgf_pos_iff` (mathlib/Mathlib/Probability/Moments/Basic.lean:205, needs `NeZero`), `mgf_nonneg` and `Finset.prod_pos`.
findings.fix: State the general lemmas first — for `μ : ι → Measure E` with `[∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]` and `f : ι → E → ℝ`: `mgf (fun x ↦ ∑ j, f j (x j)) (Measure.pi μ) t = ∏ j, mgf (f j) (μ j) t`, and `t ∈ integrableExpSet (fun x ↦ ∑ j, f j (x j)) (Measure.pi μ) ↔ ∀ j, t ∈ integrableExpSet (f j) (μ j)` — then obtain the two Gaussian statements as instances with `f j = fun u ↦ w j * u ^ 2`, `μ _ = gaussianReal 0 1`.
findings.issue: `mgf_sum_mul_sq_pi_gaussianReal_eq_prod` (:105) and `mem_integrableExpSet_sum_mul_sq_pi_gaussianReal_iff` (:115) are stated for `fun c ↦ ∑ j, w j * c j ^ 2` under `Measure.pi fun _ ↦ gaussianReal 0 1`, but neither proof uses the Gaussian law or the square; both are general facts about product measures. The PR advertises the first as reusable API for Layer 6, which makes the special-cased signature worse.

summary: Two level mismatches: the new Matrix.IsHermitian spectral lemmas are fixed at ℝ although the entire Mathlib API they build on (and the sibling file in this same PR) is RCLike-general, and the two `pi` lemmas state a purely measure-theoretic product fact only for weighted squares of standard Gaussians, with proofs that use neither Gaussianity nor squaring.
